csv_project_name: AE for Homer Municipal Airport Water Damage Repair
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Homer, Alaska is requesting proposals from qualified engineering firms to design repairs at the Homer Municipal Airport of water damage caused by a water main break. The project consists of furnishing all labor, materials, equipment, tools, supervision, and other facilities necessary to prepare planning/design documents and bid documents. We envision the project to be comprised of two stages: design and construction. The design stage would consist of preparing 65%, 95% and 100% bid documents, including obtaining all environmental and regulatory permits and incorporation of funding conditions. The construction phase would consist of providing bidding assistance, construction contract management, inspection services and project close-out services
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering

title: AE for Homer Municipal Airport Water Damage Repair
short_description: Engineering design and construction support for repairing water damage at Homer Municipal Airport.
project_scope: Repair of water damage at Homer Municipal Airport caused by a water main break. The assignment includes preparation of planning/design documents and bid documents in stages at 65%, 95%, and 100%, obtaining environmental and regulatory permits, incorporating funding conditions, and supporting the subsequent construction phase with bidding assistance, construction contract management, inspection, and close-out services.
services: Professional engineering and AE services including civil, geotechnical, environmental, electrical, and mechanical engineering; preparation of design and bid documents; permitting; bidding assistance; construction contract administration; inspection; and project close-out.
relevance_explanation:
- Airport water-damage repair project, not a bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or special structure.
- Scope is mainly multidisciplinary repair design and construction support for utility/building-related damage.
- Includes engineering design phases and construction administration, but no clear structurally demanding or innovative load-bearing structure.
- Transportation sector is generally relevant, yet this specific assignment appears routine and outside sbp's core focus.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available scope information: airport water-damage repair after a water main break; design documents at 65%, 95%, and 100%; permitting; bidding assistance; construction management; inspection; and close-out. No quantities, damaged area, building size, or repair extent are provided, so a realistic cost estimate is not possible.
fee_explanation: No fee or budget information is stated in the source. The tender is for AE/professional engineering services covering design, permitting, bidding assistance, construction contract management, inspection, and close-out, but without a construction budget or fee basis a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible.
references_qualifications: Proposals are requested from qualified engineering firms. Specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are not stated in the source. Disciplines requested: architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, environmental engineering/planning/design, electrical engineering, and mechanical engineering.
